what: human alpha-thrombin with a peptide of hirudin's C-terminal tail on its exosite

source.licence: CC0 1.0 (the archive's data are in the public domain)
source.file_is: the archive's file, unpacked and packed again (gzip, no time stamp)

chains.A: thrombin, light chain (28 residues in the model)
chains.H: the peptide, ten residues of hirudin's tail (DFEEIPEEYL), its tyrosine sulfated (TYS 63)

why_this_case: A peptide as the ligand, given as a chain of its own, with a modified residue, beside a second short chain that is not the ligand; residues numbered with insertion codes; two chains of one protein as an interface.
